speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing a psychiatric condition along with a new onset movement disorder. To help me understand your situation, can you please describe exactly what movements you are experiencing and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Risperidone-induced drug-induced parkinsonism.

Given your recent improvement on risperidone but new onset of movement issues, I need to know: Is the movement disorder characterized by tremors, stiffness, or a slow shuffling walk?
